# Prayer archive fixtures

`prayer-archive-index.json` contains synthetic data only. The three recording payloads are literal UTF-8 `bytes:clip-a.m4a`, `bytes:clip-b.ogg`, and `bytes:clip-c.wav`; they verify byte preservation, not media decoding.

`android-prayer-backup.zip` was produced on 17 November 2026 by the actual `PrayerBackupArchive.build` implementation through `PrayerBackupTest.exportCrossPlatformArchiveForJavascriptImporter` under Robolectric (SDK 33). It is not a hand-authored ZIP or a physical-device capture.

To regenerate from the frontend directory, run `android/gradlew.bat -p android :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.worship.app.PrayerBackupTest --rerun-tasks` with a working Java/Android toolchain, then copy `android/app/build/outputs/prayer-fixtures/android.zip` here. The JavaScript compatibility test imports it, rebuilds a JS archive, and restores again.

The iOS-format test re-encodes the same contract with ZIP STORE compression. It is explicitly synthetic. Replace/supplement it with an archive generated by `PrayerBackupArchive.swift` on a Mac/device before claiming iOS runtime compatibility.
